note: Bump version + sha256 together from https://pub.dev/api/packages/dartpad (archive_sha256). 0.0.9 is the newest release that still bundles web/ assets; 0.0.10 removed them in favour of `dart run dartpad setup`. See doc/releases.md in the Dart SDK for the dartpad.zip CDN alternative.
gzipNote: Shipped gzipped so the unpacked package stays under jsDelivr's 150 MB limit. Each is inflated before use: worker.wasm and sdk.tar through a fetch shim in the worker, flutter_web.js through a wrapper around $dartLoader.forceLoadScript. The .map files are inert until devtools asks for them. Everything else stays raw, so nothing the SDK loads by other means has to change.

dart.description: Dart-only DartPad SDK. Worker + DDC + analyzer + pub, console run mode.

flutter.description: Flutter DartPad SDK. Same worker plus the precompiled framework, console and flutter run modes.
